Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent dialogue portrait for a grounded medieval fantasy RPG, designed on a 74 by 100 logical pixel grid.
Substantially REDRAW the person from image 1 as a close head portrait. Image 1 provides identity, not rendering style or full-body framing. Images 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore, references ONLY for their solid facial anatomy, small low-resolution clusters and tight portrait framing; do not copy their faces.
Identity and latest-card appearance: Ousha / 欧莎 / EED-S01-NPC, a woman in her THIRTIES, ordinary local woodland patrol worker. Preserve image 1's distinctive dark brown low bun with visible grey streak through the temple, warm skin, longish defined nose, mature angular jaw and cheekbones, and faded forest-green clothing. A few greying locks do not make her elderly. Latest appearance card takes precedence over the old bareheaded reference: add a simple worn dark olive woodland cap with a LOW NARROW BRIM, without badge, feather, metal or ornate decoration; brim lightly shadows forehead but keeps brows and eyes legible. Grey temple streak and compact low bun remain visible below cap. Show a narrow faded olive-green scratch-resistant short-cloak collar over the wool-lined patrol clothing. Concerned but listening and alert, closed mouth with subtle tension, modestly uneven brows, checking a sound off to viewer-left. Experienced and cautious, not a judge, not a severe soldier, not suddenly confident or friendly. Warm weather exposure and slight eye/cheek creases appropriate for mid-thirties. No book, whistle, rope, lists or authority insignia in the portrait.
Framing: a VERY LARGE FACE. A small amount of hair or headwear at the top, head fills nearly all the canvas, strong projecting nose and broad cheekbone/jaw planes. Chin around logical y=86. Only 3–4 logical pixels of exposed neck and 7–9 pixels of narrow collar beneath. No shoulders, torso or hands. Complete crown, ears, side hair, nape and collar silhouette must be visibly uncut, with 3 logical pixels of genuine transparent clearance on every canvas edge; make this clearance in the original image rather than relying on later padding. Hair volume modest so the face stays large.
Pixel medium: hard square-edged, chunky, confidently connected pixel clusters. Flat broad forehead/cheek/nose/jaw planes. Use 3–4 large connected hair masses with angular light/shadow, not dozens of strands. Mature grounded anatomy matching the four references. Small dark eyes with only a tiny muted tan-grey sclera, no white rectangles, no glossy highlights, no anime or chibi face. Maximum 32 flat earthy colors. Fully transparent background with crisp binary-looking cutout.
Avoid airbrush, gradients, smooth painted skin, antialiasing, noisy single-pixel dithering, fine hair stripes, rim glow, glossy skin, heroic beauty pose, text, border, watermark, scene, documents, weapons and other props. One portrait only.
